question: Kishore Jena became first javelin thrower from which state to represent India at the finals of the World Athletics Championship?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kishore Jena**, an athlete from **Odisha**, has made history by becoming the first javelin thrower from the state to represent India in the **finals of the World Athletics Championship.**
 
• He achieved this milestone during the **2023 World Athletics Championships**, held in **Budapest, Hungary.**
 
• Jena qualified for the finals with an impressive throw of **80.55 meters** in the qualification round.
 
• His participation and success at the global level mark an important moment for **Odisha’s sports ecosystem**, which has seen significant growth in recent years.
 
• Odisha is known for its **support of sports infrastructure**, hosting events like the **Hockey World Cup** and training athletes in diverse disciplines.
 
• Jena’s achievement is a testimony to the **state’s evolving sports culture** and its contribution to India's athletics landscape.
 
• His performance also highlights the growing prominence of **javelin throw** as a sport in India, following the success of athletes like **Neeraj Chopra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Karnataka**__

 __
 
• **Karnataka** is a state in southern India known for its rich history, diverse culture, and contributions to sports like **cricket, hockey, and badminton.**
 
• The state is home to athletes like **Anil Kumble** in cricket and **Prakash Padukone** in badminton.
 
• However, Karnataka is not traditionally associated with javelin throw or athletics at the global level.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal**__
 __
 
• **West Bengal** is primarily known for its passion for sports like **football** and **cricket.**
 
• It has produced renowned athletes in football, including **Baichung Bhutia**, but has limited representation in javelin throw.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan**__
 
 
• **Rajasthan** is known for its contributions to sports like **wrestling, kabaddi, and shooting.**
 
• The state has produced athletes like **Apurvi Chandela** in shooting but is not prominently linked with javelin throw.
